reviewer_archetypes.title: Scientific importance and mission
reviewer_archetypes.description: Assesses importance, innovation, expected impact, and sponsor mission alignment.

reviewer_archetypes.title: Methods, rigor, and feasibility
reviewer_archetypes.description: Assesses approach, rigor, reproducibility, design validity, milestones, and feasibility.

reviewer_archetypes.title: Clinical and statistical design
reviewer_archetypes.description: Assesses clinical endpoints, estimands, sample size, recruitment, safety, and analysis.

reviewer_archetypes.title: Investigators, team, and resources
reviewer_archetypes.description: Assesses expertise, environment, facilities, governance, and team readiness.

reviewer_archetypes.title: Implementation and community impact
reviewer_archetypes.description: Assesses adoption, dissemination, equity, stakeholder engagement, and community benefit.

reviewer_archetypes.title: Research administration and compliance
reviewer_archetypes.description: Assesses submission completeness, eligibility, budget, attachments, and administrative risk.

reviewer_archetypes.title: Program mission and portfolio
reviewer_archetypes.description: Assesses strategic fit and programmatic contribution without predicting funding decisions.

core_steps.title: Analyze the grant ask
core_steps.description: Create and approve the authoritative solicitation profile, requirements, rubric, deadlines, attachments, and unresolved human questions.

core_steps.title: Approve research framework
core_steps.description: Map sponsor requirements and review criteria to the proposal argument, evidence needs, ownership, and section architecture.

core_steps.title: Lock key aims
core_steps.description: Capture structured objectives, hypotheses, aims, rationale, approach, outcomes, impact, innovation, assumptions, and evidence links.

core_steps.title: Complete literature research
core_steps.description: Run and approve a reproducible evidence search derived from the solicitation, approved framework, aims, and recorded gaps.

core_steps.title: Draft, review and export
core_steps.description: Draft from exact approved inputs, complete human review, approve exact section versions, and export a reproducible snapshot.

optional_modules.title: Opportunity and funder fit
optional_modules.description: Transparent fit and mismatch analysis for a defensible go/no-go decision without claiming award probability.
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Uses solicitation and public funder context; public-source connectors may make network requests.

optional_modules.title: Structured investigator interview
optional_modules.description: Resolve missing scientific inputs with typed, attributed answers and provenance.
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Model-assisted question generation; answers remain human-authored project records.

optional_modules.title: Clinical design and statistics
optional_modules.description: Typed study design, estimands, endpoints, power assumptions, recruitment feasibility, and consistency checks.
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Runs deterministic statistical and feasibility calculations in addition to model assistance.

optional_modules.title: Institutional memory
optional_modules.description: Reuse only approved capabilities, bios, facilities, snippets, prior proposal material, and institutional evidence with origin and review dates.
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Adds indexed institutional files and approved reusable content to project retrieval.

optional_modules.title: Competitive applicant intelligence
optional_modules.description: Evidence-backed differentiation using public grant, publication, trial, intellectual-property, and technology sources.
optional_modules.output: Differentiation strategy and monitored public evidence
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Uses configured public research connectors and may trigger scheduled refreshes.

optional_modules.title: Sponsor compliance and submission
optional_modules.description: Versioned sponsor rules, exact provenance, attachment checklist, deterministic measurements, and final preflight.
optional_modules.output: Approved rules and passing submission preflight
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Runs model-assisted rule extraction followed by deterministic validation against exact source bytes.

optional_modules.title: Review simulator and causal critique
optional_modules.description: Independent synthetic role reviews, panel synthesis, causal analysis, disagreement mapping, and a revision backlog grounded in the solicitation.
optional_modules.output: Immutable simulated review run and causal findings
optional_modules.runtime_implication: High-compute, multi-pass model operation; hybrid deployments route configured review tasks to the disclosed cloud model.

optional_modules.title: Team collaboration and approvals
optional_modules.description: Shared channels, section threads, comments, assignments, named approvals, presence, conflict handling, and auditable restoration.
optional_modules.output: Team discussion, assignment, and approval history
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Requires authenticated shared deployment for real multi-user use.

optional_modules.title: Deadline and task automation
optional_modules.description: Derived internal deadlines, owners, dependencies, reminders, escalations, and project-health reporting.
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Adds scheduled project checks and notifications; external calendar or email delivery is not enabled by default.

optional_modules.title: Full advanced workbench
optional_modules.description: Expose the existing diagnostics, specialist controls, raw artifacts, and legacy operational views.
optional_modules.runtime_implication: Changes visible controls only and never adds completion prerequisites.
